name: Voice R-7 hosted credential, spend, tenant and engine boundaries incl. hosted LiveKit (Phone) on app.papercusp.com (portal e2e, 2026-10-11 run 6)
summary: portal/e2e/portal-voice-hosted-boundaries.spec.ts ran against the live hosted portal (https://app.papercusp.com) through the canonical portal playwright.config.ts with three freshly admitted TEST tenants: 4 passed, 0 failed, exit 0. Unauthenticated: /api/voice/elevenlabs/token 401; /api/voice/engines 401; /api/papercup-chat/conversations/boundary-probe/voice-session 401, no token minted. Engines advertised exactly {"elevenlabs":false,"livekit":true}. Retired /api/device/voice/turn GET+POST 404. Browser-delivered bodies scanned for secret patterns (25 responses, 2244380 bytes, twice): 0 findings. Tenant A start burst: 6 x 404 no-agent-id (hosted ElevenLabs fails closed, unconfigured per D-007), then 429 portal_voice_start_rate_limited Retry-After 60. Tenant B after A's burst: 404 no-agent-id (not throttled). Hosted LiveKit (Phone, /api/phone): unauthenticated call 401 with no grant; tenant A's spent budget refuses a LiveKit start too (429 portal_voice_start_rate_limited); a chat id tenant B does not own 404 portal_chat_not_found; tenants B and C each got a grant (200/200) with distinct room, token and LiveKit identity, each JWT room claim matching its grant; tenant C could not list (absent), export (404) or end (404 phone_call_not_found) B's room; both rooms ended (200/200). Exact-value secret compare: 14 hosted secret values (DEEPGRAM_API_KEY, ELEVEN_API_KEY, HARNESS_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, PAPERCUSP_CLOUD_PORTAL_SECRET_PAPERCUSP_HOSTED_SESSION_COOKIE_SECRET, PAPERCUSP_CLOUD_PORTAL_SECRET_WORKOS_API_KEY, PAPERCUSP_CLOUD_PORTAL_SECRET_WORKOS_COOKIE_PASSWORD, PAPERCUSP_CLOUD_PORTAL_SECRET_WORKOS_WEBHOOK_SECRET, PHONE_AUTH_SECRET, PHONE_LIVEKIT_API_KEY, PHONE_LIVEKIT_API_SECRET, PHONE_WORKER_SECRET, STOREWOLFKEY, STOREWOLFPASSWORD). 3 TEST users cleaned up.

PASSED in 3.8s: [hosted voice boundaries (R-7)] spend + tenant: the mint never returns a key, one tenant's burst is refused, and a second tenant is untouched
PASSED in 10.6s: [hosted voice boundaries (R-7)] livekit (Phone): starts share the spend budget; each tenant gets its own room; another tenant cannot list, export or end it

exact-value compare of 14 secret values read from the hosted processes' own environment (papercusp-cloud-portal.service + papercusp-phone-sidecar.service, /proc/<pid>/environ; values never logged): DEEPGRAM_API_KEY, ELEVEN_API_KEY, HARNESS_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, PAPERCUSP_CLOUD_PORTAL_SECRET_PAPERCUSP_HOSTED_SESSION_COOKIE_SECRET, PAPERCUSP_CLOUD_PORTAL_SECRET_WORKOS_API_KEY, PAPERCUSP_CLOUD_PORTAL_SECRET_WORKOS_COOKIE_PASSWORD, PAPERCUSP_CLOUD_PORTAL_SECRET_WORKOS_WEBHOOK_SECRET, PHONE_AUTH_SECRET, PHONE_LIVEKIT_API_KEY, PHONE_LIVEKIT_API_SECRET, PHONE_WORKER_SECRET, STOREWOLFKEY, STOREWOLFPASSWORD; every scanned body (17 findings arrays across shell loads, mint, burst and LiveKit responses) matched none of them

disclosures: Hosted ElevenLabs has no agent id configured (hosted EL is out of release scope per D-007), so every ElevenLabs start fails closed with 404 no-agent-id before any token exists; there is no live ElevenLabs token to compare across tenants. Cross-tenant grant distinctness is measured live on the advertised hosted engine (LiveKit), and for ElevenLabs at the unit layer (portal/tests/a-shared-mint-is-not-a-shared-token.test.ts).
Scope note, not an R-7 gap: the hosted spoken round trip and browser microphone denial belong to R-2/R-3/R-4 and run in the guided real-microphone session (D-005, D-009).
